entries.name: Commander Neovim Config
entries.description: Install your Neovim configuration from dotfiles with a backup of existing files. Install the application separately.

entries.name: Commander Fastfetch Config
entries.description: Install your Fastfetch layout, automatic distro PNG logo and terminal-aware launcher and ImageMagick dependencies with backups. Installs Fastfetch when missing and checks image-backend support. Requires an image-capable terminal.

entries.name: Commander Starship Config
entries.description: Install your Starship configuration from dotfiles with a backup of existing files. Install the application separately.

entries.name: Commander Konsole Config
entries.description: Install your Konsole configuration from dotfiles with a backup of existing files. Install the application separately.

entries.name: Commander Ghostty Profile Config
entries.description: Install your Ghostty Profile configuration from dotfiles with a backup of existing files. Install the application separately.

entries.name: Zellij Terminal Sessions
entries.description: Install Zellij and create an optional Tokyo Night Storm preset. Preserve existing configuration; no automatic startup. Requires a distro package or an existing Zellij installation.
